scope.title: Scope
scope.body: This policy covers accidental crashes or misuse, such as jumps or falls, collisions, or impacts with rocks.

productGroup.title: Product Group
productGroup.body: Applies to all eligible Wheels/Rims. You can use the product filter on our website to identify which series your wheelset belongs to.

items.0: Crash replacement is available within three years from the date of purchase.
items.1: Replacement products are offered at a 10% discount.

conditions.title: Conditions

items.0: The Standard Crash Replacement Policy is non-transferable and applies only to the original purchaser.
items.1: If there are any issues with the replacement product, claims must be submitted within 7 days of receipt; otherwise, the case will be considered resolved.
items.2: Please note that all shipping fees, duties, taxes, and related costs are the responsibility of the customer.

conditions.note: Warranty coverage is calculated from the original purchase date. The warranty period does not reset after a rim replacement.

items.0: Once a claim is submitted, our after-sales team will contact you within 24 hours to verify details.
items.1: In most cases, you will not be required to return the damaged equipment to receive a replacement.
